headline: Ghanshyam Snacks: brand strategy, lead and traffic campaigns, and the founder's personal brand.
summary: Branding strategy, marketing, lead-generation and traffic campaigns, founder personal-brand management and founder campaigns, social content, a product film and the website gaa-tha built for a bulk peanut and white-label snacks manufacturer.
answer: gaa-tha is the retainer marketing partner for Ghanshyam Snacks, a Gujarat manufacturer of bulk peanuts and white-label snacks. We handle its branding strategy, lead-generation and traffic campaigns on Meta, a WhatsApp lead-qualification system and tracker, the founder's personal brand and founder campaigns, social content, product films and its website.
channels: Meta ads, WhatsApp, IndiaMART, Instagram, LinkedIn, website, catalogue
challenge: Ghanshyam Snacks manufactures bulk peanuts and white-label snacks for B2B buyers. Paid campaigns were producing plenty of leads, but many were fake or low-quality, the brand was not positioned for the buyers it wanted, and the founder — the company's most credible voice — was not visible online.

The company needed a partner for the whole picture: brand strategy, campaigns that bring real buyers and traffic, a system to qualify them, and a personal brand for the founder that builds trust with distributors and white-label clients.

workstreams.title: Branding strategy
workstreams.text: B2B positioning that presents Ghanshyam as a manufacturer buyers can trust, carried through a product catalogue, IndiaMART listing assets and every campaign.

workstreams.title: Lead-generation campaigns
workstreams.text: Meta lead campaigns rebuilt with a WhatsApp first-reply system that lets fake leads filter themselves out before a human replies, plus a B2B reply template for IndiaMART enquiries.

workstreams.title: Traffic campaigns
workstreams.text: Traffic campaigns that bring buyers to the website and catalogue, so prospects see the full range before they call.

workstreams.title: Lead-management SOP and tracker
workstreams.text: A five-stage pipeline — capture, 24-hour qualification, quote, Day 1/3/7 follow-up and weekly review — with a dashboard showing qualification rate, conversion rate, pipeline value and junk percentage by ad source.

workstreams.title: Founder personal brand and founder campaigns
workstreams.text: Personal-brand management for the founder — positioning, content and founder-led campaigns on Instagram and LinkedIn — so the person behind the factory becomes the brand's strongest proof.

workstreams.title: Social media and product films
workstreams.text: 50-post content sets, reel production briefs, and a cinematic sand-roasted peanut macro film that makes a commodity look premium.

workstreams.title: Website — built and managed
workstreams.text: We built and manage the Ghanshyam Snacks website as the destination for traffic campaigns and the first stop for B2B buyers.

results: Ghanshyam Snacks now has a brand positioned for B2B buyers, campaigns for both leads and traffic, a pipeline that shows which ad sources produce buyers, and a visible founder. Lead volumes, qualified-lead rate, website traffic and founder content reach are published once confirmed from the tracker and platforms.

faq.q: Who handles marketing for Ghanshyam Snacks?
faq.a: gaa-tha handles Ghanshyam Snacks' branding strategy, lead-generation and traffic campaigns, lead qualification system, founder personal brand and founder campaigns, social content, product films and website on a retainer.

faq.q: How does gaa-tha filter fake leads from Meta ads?
faq.a: A WhatsApp first-reply step lets low-intent and fake leads drop out before a salesperson replies, and a tracker scores every ad source on qualified leads rather than raw volume.

faq.q: Does gaa-tha manage founders' personal brands?
faq.a: Yes. For Ghanshyam Snacks we manage the founder's personal brand — positioning, content and founder-led campaigns on Instagram and LinkedIn.
